2026_05_DET_ARI.headline: Detroit’s offensive balance meets Arizona’s challenge in space
2026_05_DET_ARI.paragraph1: Detroit travels to Arizona with an opportunity to stress the Cardinals through a balanced attack that forces defenders to honor both the run and play-action. Arizona’s response must be disciplined tackling and coverage communication, particularly when Detroit creates favorable angles after motion. The Cardinals can counter by using their own offensive versatility to keep Detroit from committing extra defenders to one phase. If Arizona falls behind the chains, however, the Lions can play more aggressively against predictable passing situations. Sustaining early-down efficiency is central to both teams’ plans.
2026_05_DET_ARI.model_rationale: Detroit benefits when its rushing and passing threats reinforce one another. Arizona needs disciplined defensive spacing and sustained offensive possessions to prevent the Lions from controlling the tempo.
